summary: Lead research for Landlord MVP (property management/tenant screening/rental tools). Targets local property managers, housing authorities, and landlords needing tenant screening, rent collection, and compliance tools.

leads.fit_rationale: Manages public housing and Section 8 vouchers; needs landlord onboarding tools, tenant screening integration, and compliance tracking. Already partners with AffordableHousing.com for listings.
Requires landlords to register properties, pay occupancy permits, and pass inspections. A landlord portal for registration and inspection scheduling would streamline operations.
Publishes landlord-tenant guides and handles fair housing complaints. Could distribute digital tools for landlord compliance and tenant rights education.

leads.organization: Ashtabula County Mental Health and Recovery Services Board
leads.fit_rationale: Administers HUD rental assistance for homeless individuals/families. Needs landlord recruitment tools and housing placement tracking.
Local property manager that could benefit from tenant screening, maintenance ticketing, and rent collection automation.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add a landlord compliance checklist with automated reminders for inspections and permit renewals.
Integrate tenant screening with credit/criminal background checks.
Provide online rent collection with automatic late fee calculations.
Include maintenance request ticketing with photo upload and vendor assignment.
Add document storage for leases, inspection reports, and tenant communications.
Offer Ohio-specific lease templates compliant with ORC Chapter 5321.
Create a landlord dashboard showing occupancy rates, rent roll, and maintenance costs.

possible_issues: If the interface feels too consumer-focused, professional landlords may not trust it.
Missing data tables or reporting views would frustrate portfolio managers.
Lack of mobile responsiveness hurts landlords who work in the field.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Property management tools can be white-labeled for housing authorities, city housing departments, or property management companies with branding and custom workflows.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Reach out to AMHA about landlord portal integration for Section 8 program.
Contact City of Ashtabula Housing Department about digitizing landlord registration and inspection scheduling.
Explore partnerships with local property management companies for pilot testing.
